scope: Outcome-independent stratified 64-case task-quality diagnostic; no quality or performance qualification.

selection.algorithm: Within each zero_shot/eight_shot stratum sort ascending by SHA256 UTF-8(seed + id), tie-break by id; take the first 32 each; execute selected IDs in original suite order.

experiment_conditions.generation: Original greedy, original EOS, 512 token cap, exact frozen prompt tokens and original numeric-answer scorer; fresh processes, identical existing binary and four fixed ordered batches of 16 per arm.
experiment_conditions.configuration: Only model path and listen port are passed. Vision enabled, normal automatic execution/resources and tuning. Both arms copy the completed prior baseline tuning cache; resulting caches are retained. No profiler.
experiment_conditions.environment: External 1-second global GPU and compute PID/executable/memory samples begin before model startup and span both arms. Existing desktop tenants remain; no exclusivity claim. These are task-quality outputs, not timing samples. No unrelated processes are stopped.
experiment_conditions.stopping: Complete all 64 cases in each arm regardless of gross losses or gains. Only execution or environment failures can interrupt the run. Retain partial outputs on failure; no retries or replacement cases.

limitations: The source 1024-case corpus was used in earlier investigations. Selection is independent of outcomes, but this is not an unseen holdout.
Only 64 cases, 32 in each stratum, and one process per arm. One case is 1.5625 percentage points overall; this does not establish a small non-inferiority margin.
The net observed change is minus one correct answer, with two losses and one gain. Neither equivalent task quality nor a population decline is established.
All length-limited and missing-answer outcomes remain in the denominator. No cases were replaced, retried or excluded.
Read-only environment monitoring retained desktop programs. No exclusive-GPU or performance claim.
The formal gross-regression gate and default 2048-position precision guard are unchanged.
